lines.text: Gain 16% more Armor and Magic Resist and 20% Tenacity. Below 40% max Health this doubles to 32% and 40%.
Gain 20 Armor, then increase your bonus Armor by 25%.
Gain 20 Magic Resist, then increase your bonus Magic Resist by 25%.

Every 6 seconds, release a burst of slime that deals 40–80 + 3–6% max Health magic damage (by level) to nearby enemies. Hitting a champion leaves a blob that heals you for 3–7% max Health when you walk over it; enemies can destroy it.
